target_customer: International students in Los Angeles renting furnished rooms
problem: International students struggle to find furnished, lease-by-the-bedroom housing without a US credit history. Union Apartment leased buildings and rented furnished bedrooms to them.
business_model: Master lease and sublease of furnished bedrooms (co-living rent)

founders.name: Yihsuan Chen
founders.background_notes: YC page lists three founders with no backgrounds.

investors: Family Angel Management Fund I LLC

competitors.name: Ollie
competitors.what: Co-living operator that planned a Los Angeles location
competitors.traction_then: Planned an LA location for late 2019

competitors.name: PodShare
competitors.what: Hostel style shared housing near UCLA used by program participants without university housing
competitors.traction_then: About 200 beds across five LA locations

technical_complexity.rationale: A real estate operating business with no meaningful technology risk.

defensibility.rationale: Leases and furniture are replicable, though sourcing buildings and serving students from specific countries could build some community.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Tripalink, a student focused co-living company with about 900 beds near USC per a November 2019 release, operated in the same market. No acquisition of Union Apartment was found.

market_need_then: Large numbers of international students attend USC and other LA schools and need housing near campus. The company's Product Hunt page says it ran 150 units (undated).

branding.domain_note: Used unionapt.live, a .live domain rather than a .com. The domain now redirects to unionvillas.live (301), a site for Union Villas LLC offering student housing near USC.

identity.voice_and_tone: Community framing: helps people from the same background make a little bit of their country in the buildings (Product Hunt text)

rebrands.why: Not stated. The domain redirects and the new site offers similar housing, but no source states the link between the companies.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared by countless apartment buildings and a non .com domain; no press about the brand.

outcome_analysis: Union Apartment ran furnished co-living for international students around USC and reported operating about 150 units on Product Hunt in 2019. The YC directory lists it inactive, but its old domain redirects to Union Villas LLC, which still markets student housing, so it may have continued under another name. No shutdown announcement or cause was found, so the cause is not public. The brand_confusion tag is a low confidence note about the generic name.
notes: The $150K figure rests on Village (aggregator) and Crustdata YC investment May 2019; the other named investors may belong to other undated rounds. Crunchbase says founded 2017. Company site redirects to a similar business; the relationship is unconfirmed. Tripalink (Nov 2019) and Common (2019) are later than the batch window so not listed as competitors. Product Hunt launch was 2019-04-18. Product Hunt unit count is undated.
